newsitem.title: USA: Main Street Athletic says to buy Va. land.
newsitem.headline: Main Street Athletic says to buy Va. land.

text.p: Main Street Athletic Clubs Inc said Thursday it has secured the option, and plans to buy, the controlling rights to 50,000 acres of land in and around Norfolk County, Virginia.
The company said the $5.4 million purchase will be liquidated during the next three years to help finance its ongoing acquisition program.
A company spokesman said Main Street is also looking into mining parts of the land, or developing it further for business or residential use.
Main Street said it believes some parts of the land has already been developed for commercial or residential use.
In a written statement, the company said that "as unfortunate as it may be for the title companies and developers, it seems that these companies may end up with a new partner."
